subject: general
question: Which of the following is the indigenously developed Beyond-Visual-Range Air- to-Air Missile (BVRAAM), successfully test-fired by the Indian Air Force in September 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Astra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Astra missile** is the indigenously developed Beyond-Visual-Range Air-to-Air Missile (BVRAAM) by India.
 
• It was successfully test-fired by the Indian Air Force in September 2018.
 
• The Astra missile is designed to engage and destroy highly maneuvering supersonic aircraft.
 
• It is capable of engaging targets at varying ranges and altitudes.
 
• The successful test-firing of Astra showcases India’s prowess in developing advanced weaponry and strengthens the country’s defense capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BrahMos** is a medium-range ramjet supersonic cruise missile that can be launched from submarines, ships, aircraft, or land.
 
• **Prahaar** is a short-range ballistic missile developed for quick strikes against tactical targets.
 
• **Dhanush** is a variant of the surface-to-surface or ship-to-ship Prithvi missile.
 
• The development and successful testing of indigenous missiles like Astra are crucial for India's strategic and defense autonomy.
